data.value:
Quesadilla - written by Izakbar. Some ideas taken from T.A.C.O.
Thank you to my wonderful testers : Paul Hipster Malcolmson, Ultimate-pilot Destiny and Zubenelgenubi. Special thanks to Kleo Azu for letting me bounce ideals off of them putting up with my constant screenshots on slack
Special thanks to : T.A.C.O. For something to start with :) EVE-O Preview (https://github.com/EveOPlus/eve-o-preview) which has been invaluable for me when playing eve - and for working out how to find active eve clients. EVE Combat Log Analyzer (http://evelog.mikk36.eu/) made working out DPS a bit easier ! SMT for being so useful CCP for EVEOnline and GM's for giving me their time. EVEStandard for ESI Library Cyotek.Windows.Forms.ColorPicker - so much nicer than standard :)
